title: LearnOps slide index (B6.2, v1)
description: The slides.json file in a lesson folder (PRD B6.2): a bare JSON array of {t, thumb, text?}, one entry per slide change. t is a number of seconds from the beginning of the main track; fractional seconds are allowed. thumb is a path relative to the lesson folder whose first segment is slides/ and whose file name has at least one character before the lowercase extension .jpg.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced by this file: that the thumbnail file exists and is 320 px wide; that every t is at most the manifest's duration_s (another file, so a consumer-level rule); that the entries are in ascending order of t (not decided by the guide, so not required). The file name has no fixed number of digits. text is plain text with no length or format restriction in v1.

relative_path.description: The relative-path rule of the lesson manifest (contracts/lesson-manifest.v1.schema.json, $defs/relative_path; PRD B6.3, C-08), copied here with the same pattern text so that this file can be used on its own. A test fails if the two patterns differ. The path is relative to the lesson folder.

t.description: Seconds from the beginning of the main track, at least 0. Fractional seconds are allowed. The moment the slide appears.

thumb.description: Thumbnail path relative to the lesson folder: the manifest relative-path rule, first segment slides, file name with at least one character before the lowercase extension .jpg.

text.description: Optional plain text of the slide. No length or format restriction in v1.
